symptoms.symptom: The appliance is not cooling, the displays and lighting are lit.

causes.label: Demo mode is switched on.
remedies: Press and hold alarm off for 15 seconds until three audible signals sound.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "Demo mode is switched on."

causes.label: a "alarm off" flashes and a warning signal sounds.
remedies: Press alarm off.
After a short time, check whether your appliance is cooling.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "a "alarm off" flashes and a warning signal sounds."

symptoms.symptom: The LED lighting does not work.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Call customer service.
→ "Customer Service", Page 31
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: The refrigeration unit is switching on more frequently and for longer.

causes.label: The appliance has been opened frequently.
remedies: Do not open appliance door unnecessarily.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "The appliance has been opened frequently."

causes.label: External ventilation openings are covered up.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "External ventilation openings are covered up."

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently.
remedies: Remove any obstructions from in front of the external ventilation openings.
Install the appliance as far away as possible from heating elements, cookers and other heat sources. Avoid prolonged exposure of the appliance to direct sunlight.
Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines switch on more frequently and have different power levels to cool more efficiently."

symptoms.symptom: A layer of frost forms on the back wall of the refrigerator compartment.

causes.label: Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals.
remedies: Only open the appliance door as briefly as necessary.
Pack the food airtight or cover it.
Allow hot food and drinks to cool down first before storing in the appliance.
Always leave some space between the food and the interior walls.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "Not a fault. Modern refrigeration machines ensure a more even temperature in the refrigerator compartment. The back wall of the refrigerator compartment is defrosted automatically at regular intervals."

symptoms.symptom: Home Connect® is not working properly.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Go to www.home-connect.com.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: "E" or "d" appears on the temperature display.

causes.label: The electronics have detected a fault.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. → Page 14
Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Reconnect the appliance after 5 minutes.
Switch on the appliance. → Page 14
If the message still appears on the display, call Customer Service.
→ "Customer Service", Page 31
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 28: "The electronics have detected a fault."

symptoms.symptom: A warning signal sounds and "alarm off" flashes.

causes.label: The appliance door is open.
remedies: Close the appliance door.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "The appliance door is open."

symptoms.symptom: The temperature differs greatly from the setting.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. → Page 14
Switch the appliance back on after approximately 5 minutes. → Page 14
‒ If the temperature is too warm, check the temperature again after a couple of hours.
‒ If the temperature is too cold, check the temperature again on the following day.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Various causes are possible."

symptoms.symptom: Water is leaking out of the appliance.

causes.label: The water connection or water hose is not leak-tight.
remedies: Check if the water connections are fastened firmly and the water hose is undamaged.
If necessary, replace the water hose.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "The water connection or water hose is not leak-tight."

causes.label: Low water pressure.
remedies: Check the pressure of the water supply system or the external water filter system, e.g. reverse osmosis system.
Connect the appliance only to a water connection with sufficient water pressure.
→ Page 7
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Low water pressure."

causes.label: The water filter is blocked.
remedies: Change the water filter. → Page 20
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "The water filter is blocked."

symptoms.symptom: Water is dripping from the water dispenser.

causes.label: Air is in the water system.
remedies: Keep dispensing water until it contains no more air.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Air is in the water system."

symptoms.symptom: The water dispenser is not functioning.

causes.label: There is no water being supplied to the appliance.
remedies: Ensure that there is a water supply and that the shut-off valve on the water connection is open.
Contact an installer if necessary.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "There is no water being supplied to the appliance."

causes.label: Kink in the water hose.
remedies: Turn off the water supply and straighten the kink in water hose.
If necessary, replace the water hose.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Kink in the water hose."

causes.label: The appliance has only recently been connected.
remedies: Wait approximately 4 hours until the first batch of ice cubes is ready.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "The appliance has only recently been connected."

causes.label: The freezer compartment has been opened frequently or for an extended period of time.
remedies: Check ice cube production after a few hours.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "The freezer compartment has been opened frequently or for an extended period of time."

causes.label: Low water pressure.
remedies: Check the pressure of the water supply system or the external water filter system, e.g. reverse osmosis system.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 29: "Low water pressure."

symptoms.symptom: The ice maker is not functioning.

causes.label: Ice cube production is switched off.
remedies: Switch on ice cube production. → Page 21
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "Ice cube production is switched off."

causes.label: There is no water being supplied to the appliance.
remedies: Ensure that there is a water supply and that the shut-off valve on the water connection is open.
Contact an installer if necessary.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "There is no water being supplied to the appliance."

causes.label: Kink in the water hose.
remedies: Turn off the water supply and straighten the kink in water hose.
If necessary, replace the water hose.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "Kink in the water hose."

causes.label: Fault in the ice maker.
remedies: Switch off the appliance. → Page 14
Disconnect the appliance from the power supply.
Unplug the power plug or switch off the circuit breaker in the fuse box.
Reconnect the appliance after 5 minutes.
Switch on the appliance. → Page 14
If the fault persists, call customer service. → Page 31
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 30: "Fault in the ice maker."
